entries.title: Job 31:1
segments: ¶I made an agreement with my eyes; how then might my eyes be looking on a virgin?

entries.title: Job 31:2
segments: For what is God's reward from on high, or the heritage given by the Ruler of all from heaven?

entries.title: Job 31:3
segments: Is it not trouble for the sinner, and destruction for the evil-doers?

entries.title: Job 31:4
segments: Does he not see my ways, and are not my steps all numbered?

entries.title: Job 31:5
segments: If I have gone in false ways, or my foot has been quick in working deceit;

entries.title: Job 31:6
segments: (Let me be measured in upright scales, and let God see my righteousness:)

entries.title: Job 31:7
segments: If my steps have been turned out of the way, or if my heart went after my eyes, or if the property of another is in my hands;

entries.title: Job 31:8
segments: Let me put seed in the earth for another to have the fruit of it, and let my produce be uprooted.

entries.title: Job 31:9
segments: ¶If my heart went after another man's wife, or if I was waiting secretly at my neighbour's door;

entries.title: Job 31:10
segments: Then let my wife give pleasure to another man and let others make use of her body.

entries.title: Job 31:11
segments: For that would be a crime; it would be an act for which punishment would be measured out by the judges:

entries.title: Job 31:12
segments: It would be a fire burning even to destruction, and taking away all my produce.

entries.title: Job 31:13
segments: If I did wrong in the cause of my man-servant, or my woman-servant, when they went to law with me;

entries.title: Job 31:14
segments: What then will I do when God comes as my judge? and what answer may I give to his questions?

entries.title: Job 31:15
segments: Did not God make him as well as me? did he not give us life in our mothers' bodies?

entries.title: Job 31:16
segments: ¶If I kept back the desire of the poor; if the widow's eye was looking for help to no purpose;

entries.title: Job 31:17
segments: If I kept my food for myself, and did not give some of it to the child with no father;

entries.title: Job 31:18
segments: (For I was cared for by God as by a father from my earliest days; he was my guide from the body of my mother;)

entries.title: Job 31:19
segments: If I saw one near to death for need of clothing, and that the poor had nothing covering him;

entries.title: Job 31:20
segments: If his back did not give me a blessing, and the wool of my sheep did not make him warm;

entries.title: Job 31:21
segments: If my hand had been lifted up against him who had done no wrong, when I saw that I was supported by the judges;

entries.title: Job 31:22
segments: May my arm be pulled from my body, and be broken from its base.

entries.title: Job 31:23
segments: For the fear of God kept me back, and because of his power I might not do such things.

entries.title: Job 31:24
segments: ¶If I made gold my hope, or if I ever said to the best gold, I have put my faith in you;

entries.title: Job 31:25
segments: If I was glad because my wealth was great, and because my hand had got together a great store;

entries.title: Job 31:26
segments: If, when I saw the sun shining, and the moon moving on its bright way,

entries.title: Job 31:27
segments: A secret feeling of worship came into my heart, and my hand gave kisses from my mouth;

entries.title: Job 31:28
segments: That would have been another sin to be rewarded with punishment by the judges; for I would have been false to God on high.

entries.title: Job 31:29
segments: If I was glad at the trouble of my hater, and gave cries of joy when evil overtook him;

entries.title: Job 31:30
segments: (For I did not let my mouth give way to sin, in putting a curse on his life;)

entries.title: Job 31:31
segments: If the men of my tent did not say, Who has not had full measure of his meat?

entries.title: Job 31:32
segments: The traveller did not take his night's rest in the street, and my doors were open to anyone on a journey;

entries.title: Job 31:33
segments: ¶If I kept my evil doings covered, and my sin in the secret of my breast,

entries.title: Job 31:34
segments: For fear of the great body of people, or for fear that families might make sport of me, so that I kept quiet, and did not go out of my door;

entries.title: Job 31:35
segments: If only God would give ear to me, and the Ruler of all would give me an answer! or if what he has against me had been put in writing!

entries.title: Job 31:36
segments: Truly I would take up the book in my hands; it would be to me as a crown;

entries.title: Job 31:37
segments: I would make clear the number of my steps, I would put it before him like a prince! The words of Job are ended.

entries.title: Job 31:38
segments: If my land has made an outcry against me, or the ploughed earth has been in sorrow;

entries.title: Job 31:39
segments: If I have taken its produce without payment, causing the death of its owners;

entries.title: Job 31:40
segments: Then in place of grain let thorns come up, and in place of barley evil-smelling plants.
